subject: Quick follow-up after missed demo — can we do a short tech sync?
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Shaw <ellen.shaw@novaforce.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up after missed demo — can we do a short tech sync?

Hi Ellen —

I’m sorry we missed each other earlier today. I was told there was an unexpected travel reroute on your side — hope everything’s OK. We’re still excited to walk through how Redwood can help NovaForce reduce inference costs for real-time recommendations.

If today is still hectic, two options that usually work:
- A focused 20-minute architecture + latency walkthrough with Marcus (our VP of Solutions) — he can dive straight into your integration questions.
- A full 45-minute demo next week if you’d prefer a broader product tour.

Would you prefer option 1 or 2? If it’s easier, I can have Marcus run the short session and we’ll hand off any procurement questions to Monica. I attached a one-pager that highlights the integration pattern and the SOW draft for your review.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Reply with preferred slot type (20m vs 45m)
2) If 20m, pick one of Marcus’s quick slots below and I’ll send an invite

Marcus’s availability (PST): Mon 3/6 10:00–11:30, Tue 3/7 14:00–15:30, Wed 3/8 09:00–10:00.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: SOW_draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 78KB); demo_highlights_onepager.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Ellen Shaw <ellen.shaw@novaforce.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after missed demo — can we do a short tech sync?

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for checking in. Sorry again — my flight got diverted and I was stuck in the airport for several hours. I appreciate the flexibility.

A 20-minute focused session sounds perfect. We’re primarily worried about (1) latency under bursty traffic, and (2) what parts of the pipeline require code changes vs config. If Marcus can address those two items and show a brief example integration, that would be ideal.

I can do Monday 3/6 at 10:15am PST, or Tuesday 3/7 late afternoon (after 3pm PST). Either one works — please pick whichever is easier for Marcus.

Also: can you send a short recording or the one-pager after the session for our procurement team? I looped procurement here in case we need to move faster on contractual items.

Best,
Ellen Shaw
Director, Platform Engineering | NovaForce
ellen.shaw@novaforce.com
